summary: More cloudfront_distribution items deprecations: lambda_function_associations, cache_behaviors, custom_error_responses and default_cache_behavior sub-fields now use elements.
questions: Is items deprecated in default_cache_behavior output of cloudfront_distribution?
What key replaces items in custom_error_responses?

answer_card.title: cloudfront_distribution items → elements (part 2)
answer_card.answer_md: Also deprecated in favor of `elements` (removal after 2026-12-15): `items` in `cache_behaviors.items.lambda_function_associations`, `cache_behaviors`, `custom_error_responses`, and in `default_cache_behavior`: `allowed_methods`, `allowed_methods.cached_methods`, `forwarded_values.cookies.whitelisted_names` and `forwarded_values.headers`.
